definitions.postproc: per-class LCC then opening, spherical SE r=3 mm at 1 mm isotropic (draft §4.6); postproc_tumor_exempt: tumor class opening only
definitions.repair: kg_guided_segment.repair: LCC per organ + drop tumor components not within 3 vox of an organ
definitions.volume_MAPE_pct: pooled over reference organ observations with a predicted organ node (closing_the_loop.py definition)
definitions.volume_MAPE_pct_strict: as above but a missing predicted organ node counts as 100 % error
definitions.organ_site_fidelity: (organ nodes with correct identity + lesion nodes matched by IoU>=0.3 with correct located_in and containment) / (reference nodes + spurious predicted nodes)
definitions.triple_F1: macro over patients; triples mirror kg_build_graph.py edges; lesion nodes matched patient-wise by Hungarian IoU>=0.3
definitions.retrieval: queries = the patients, candidates = the other patients of the same mask source, relevance from the reference-graph records; mismatch@10 generalised to multi-organ queries
definitions.stats: paired patient bootstrap B=5000, sign-flip permutation B=20000, Holm within F3 (triple F1)
